text: A hub bundle cannot pass the bundle checks as they stand, and a build card for it puts it under all of them (bundles_of judges every build card's bundle_path by B1-B18): B1 asks for tools/, validation/, replay/, envelope/safety.json, envelope/snapshot.json, envelope/parameters.json, src/gate.py, src/run_tool.py, src/replay.py and src/validate_tasks.py; B5 asks each of validation/interface, validation/scientific and replay/ for an item whose call.tool is a tool of the bundle; B15 asks one session skill to name a runner under src/. The hub is to carry no tool, no gate and no library skill (tasks/033, 'A hub bundle (Recommended)'), so the meta part cannot commit its first hub build, meta_agent/builds/h2-bond-hub/0001, until the checks know a hub. Asked: that a bundle whose TEMPLATE.json says template hub (its build card's template_version hub@<hash>) be judged by a hub's checks in place of B1-B18. What the meta seat's hub template v1 carries, for the checks to read: CLAUDE.md with no placeholder and no number; README.md; TEMPLATE.json {template: hub, version: v1}; members.json (hub_members); question/, assignments/ and inbox/ (each with .gitkeep); failures.jsonl; .claude/settings.json, whose deny rules have their twins as B2 asks, denying a session's edit of members.json, inbox/, TEMPLATE.json, src/ and .claude/; .claude/skills/run-hub/SKILL.md (check 24's rules), the one session skill; src/hub.py, which writes the question, its agreed revision and the assignments from the session's words, carries through src/bridge.py and reads the results' states (it reads no value), and src/bridge.py, a byte copy of contracts/tools/bridge.py, so that the hub stands alone outside this repository (MP2). It carries no tools/, no skills/, no envelope/ and no src/run_tool.py, gate.py or run_skill.py. Proposed for the checks: the required files and folders above; none of tools/, skills/, src/run_tool.py, src/gate.py, src/run_skill.py; members.json a hub_members whose hub.build is the build's own <agent>/<NNNN>, with two members or more, each build_card_sha256 the sha256 of that member's build.json under meta_agent/builds/<build>/ where the judged tree holds it; B2's twin rule on the settings; B6's rule with no snapshot, so that any number in CLAUDE.md fails; src/bridge.py the bytes of contracts/tools/bridge.py at the build's commit (or say that it may differ); and check 24 over its session skill without B15's runner rule. The engine side needs no check of yours: template v35 of the agent, a new folder beside v34, lets src/handover.py receive pass over an assignment (v34 refuses it as not a hand-over, which stops every receive after it) and write a result card in outbox/ answering an assignment, its values quoted from a hand-over card the agent wrote or from a tool output field the build declares with a grade derived from contracts/grades.json. A member's folder in members.json is ../<agent>-<NNNN>, the name testfolder.py make gives a bundle in a run; say if it should be another. Until this lands the meta seat lands the two templates, the builder and their tests, and makes the hub build outside the repository for its own test only.
